description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Whale orders and net whale buy/sell for one Hyperliquid coin (e.g. BTC, SOL, HYPE) plus mark price, 24h change, funding and open interest. Returns JSON whale orders and net buy or sell for that coin, plus mark, 24h change, funding, and open interest.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

coin.description: Hyperliquid coin. Format: a coin symbol. Example: SOL. The tool text also names BTC and HYPE. Required.

min_usd.description: Minimum order notional in USD. Format: a number. Example: 100000. Omit to use the server's current floor.

window.description: Look-back window. Format: one of the allowed values. Example: 1h. Allowed values: 15m, 1h, 4h, 24h, 7d.

name: whale_token
title: Whale flow for one coin ($0.005)
